title: Expanded classic-indicator candidates within three families, keep exactly three (one per family), train/holdout split
type: confirmation-utility measurement only; no trade management, no stop, no fees, no capital, no live

structure_baseline.rule: each candidate is an independent LEVEL confirmation per structure, then combined across the 3 structures the SAME way for every candidate; no priority ordering; no dropping simultaneous signals

confirmation_form.decision: LEVEL condition evaluated at the decision bar i (matches L0073/74/76 lineage; edge/cross form would collapse coverage)
confirmation_form.math_source: history/hyp_lab/l0072_ind.py (registered defs, blob 716b6a5); thresholds from L0072
confirmation_form.recorded_difference: L0072 registered TRIGGERS are edge/cross events (I01-I14); L0077 uses the LEVEL state of the same math+thresholds at bar i. Difference (edge-vs-level) recorded here in §2 per task.
confirmation_form.causality: value at i uses data <= i only; Donchian lo20/hi20 use shift(1).rolling(20) so only bars < i; no future in trigger

bollinger_zscore_note: Bollinger and Z-Score are ONE family member 'BollingerZ' (z=+/-2 equals BB(20,2) bands, per docs/lanes/L0072-VERDICT.md). No separate Z candidate.

ADX_DI.method: Wilder RMA seeded by first valid value

registered_math_notes.wilder: out=nan;s=nan; per value skip nan; s=v if s is nan else s+(v-s)/n
registered_math_notes.rsi: diff prepend nan; up[0]=dn[0]=nan; au/ad=wilder(n); ad==0 -> 100
registered_math_notes.mfi: tp=(h+l+c)/3; mf=tp*v; rolling14 sum of mf split by sign(diff tp); neg==0 -> 100

time_split.rule: select each name from train only; freeze names in a separate commit BEFORE reading holdout; do NOT use L0076 results

validity_gates_train.beat_random: directional accuracy must exceed random median
validity_gates_train.no_valid_in_family: do NOT force; verdict becomes 'لم يوجد اختيار ثلاثي صالح'

outcome_definition.base: +1 ATR before -1 ATR within 6 bars (L0073 def)
outcome_definition.reference_price: close of the confirmation-decision bar i

random_control.method: per-symbol/per-structure fixed-k resample of decided structure outcomes

report_must_show: accuracy AND coverage together (high accuracy with collapsed coverage / small n is NOT success)
